{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_credit_amount_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized log credit amount for smooth linear margin contribution.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_numeric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth normalized severity score of loan size for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(credit_amount) - np.log1p(3555.18)) / 0.85"
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized loan duration in months.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_numeric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear projection on duration risk axis; longer loans typically higher risk.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(duration - 22.21) / 13.25"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized applicant age.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "normalized_numeric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth age signal for linear SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 35.47) / 11.09"
    },
    {
      "name": "amount_per_month",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Approximate monthly repayment burden (credit_amount divided by duration).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5000.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous severity ratio capturing repayment intensity, useful for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "credit_amount / np.maximum(duration, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "installment_burden_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of installment commitment and log credit amount.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines two repayment-burden indicators into a single linear-friendly score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "installment_commitment * np.log1p(credit_amount) / 4.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "checking_status_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal severity of checking account balance (lower balance = higher severity).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ordinal projection for linear SVM, captures known strong risk signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(checking_status == '<0', 1.0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 0.66, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 0.33, 0.0)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "savings_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal severity of savings level (less savings = higher severity).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear ordinal feature for savings adequacy.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(savings_status == '<100', 1.0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 0.75, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 0.5, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 0.25, 0.0))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_stability",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal employment duration (higher = more stable).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures employment tenure on a continuous scale for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0.0, np.where(employment == '<1', 0.25, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 0.5, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 0.75, 1.0))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_history_risk",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal risk encoding from credit history categories.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear severity projection of historical repayment behavior.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(credit_history == 'no credits/all paid', 1.0, np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 0.85, np.where(credit_history == 'delayed previously', 0.6, np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 0.35, 0.1))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_to_age_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Loan duration relative to applicant age, capturing commitment length vs life stage.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ratio useful for linear separation between younger long-term borrowers and older short-term borrowers.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "duration / np.maximum(age, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "applicant_stability_composite",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment score combining housing ownership, property magnitude, telephone ownership, and foreign worker status into an overall financial-stability score (higher = more stable applicant profile).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single dense stability axis aids linear SVM by aggregating weak categorical signals.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "loan_purpose_risk_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic risk score for loan purpose based on general lending domain knowledge (e.g., new car/business higher risk, used car/radio-tv lower). Encoded on a continuous 0-1 risk axis without using outcome data.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses high-cardinality purpose into a smooth linear-friendly risk score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
